import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending for each customer
df['Total_Spending'] = df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds']

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Marital_Status', y='Total_Spending', palette='pastel')

# Adding title and labels
plt.title('Total Spending by Marital Status', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
